name: CockroachDB
model: Tables of rows with SQL, speaking the PostgreSQL wire protocol and much of its dialect; data split into ranges spread over many nodes
engine_note: Pebble (a RocksDB-style LSM key-value store) on each node; rows are keys in ranges, each range replicated by Raft (3 copies by default)
consistency: Multi-row, cross-node transactions. Default isolation serializable; read committed is an option you enable. A write commits once a Raft majority of the range's replicas has it. Normal reads are current; follower reads (AS OF SYSTEM TIME) are deliberately slightly stale.

jepsen.finding: Found serializability violations (duplicate inserts from a timestamp cache bug and from network retries); fixed in beta-20160915 and beta-20161013, after which tests passed.

scaling: Automatic sharding by key range: add nodes and ranges rebalance by themselves; multi-region tables pin data near users; serverless tiers in the cloud.
licence: CockroachDB Software License (source available; Enterprise Free tier for individuals and businesses under 10M USD revenue, with required telemetry)

licence_events.event: Moves the core from Apache 2.0 to the Business Source License 1.1 (converting to Apache 2.0 after three years), with enterprise features under the CockroachDB Community License.

Announces retirement of the free Core edition: from 24.3 (November 2024) all self-hosted use is under the CockroachDB Software License, free only via Enterprise Free (under 10M USD annual revenue, telemetry required) or trials.

managed: CockroachDB Cloud (Basic, Standard, Advanced) on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure
version_note: v26.3 is an optional Innovation release; the latest Regular (long-supported) series is v26.2 (GA 2026-04-27; GitHub tags reach v26.2.7).
reach: Reach for it when you need SQL transactions that keep working if a node or zone dies, writes in several regions, or more write load than one Postgres primary.
avoid: Avoid when one Postgres box is enough (it is slower per query and costs more), you need Postgres extensions, or the licence terms do not fit.
escape: You leave the Postgres default for this because writes outgrow one machine or you need to survive a region failure.
chat: Users, chats and messages when the product is global and must keep writes local to each region.
notes: Current LICENSE file on master is titled 'CockroachDB Software License'; v19.2.0 LICENSE shows BSL 1.1 plus CCL. Licensing FAQ confirms Enterprise Free requires telemetry (clusters throttled after 7 days without it). The 2019 blog is gone from the live site (404); date 2019-06-04 read from the Wayback Machine copy's datePublished. Jepsen notes CockroachDB provides serializability, not strict serializability. The GitHub tags API did not show a v26.3.0 tag when queried, though the docs list v26.3.0 GA 2026-08-19; date of patch v26.2.7 not confirmed.
